d:
A group gathers.
It is a time of displacement, struggle and social instability. The government uses an A.I. created by a company named Syb1l to "delist" people, essentially making them unable to participate in society if they are deemed problematic in any way, even for speaking up or attending protests. But as more people are delisted and society grows increasingly unstable as their jobs disappear, they use their invisibility to gather, organize, and fight back.
